senses.sense_definition: The act of beating or whipping someone, often as a form of punishment or religious penance.

examples.text: The historical practice of <w>flagellation</w> was once common in certain religious orders as a form of self-mortification.
The prisoner was sentenced to public <w>flagellation</w> for his crimes against the state.

senses.sense_definition: The development or arrangement of flagella in biological organisms.

examples.text: The study focused on the <w>flagellation</w> patterns of various aquatic microorganisms.
Researchers observed the <w>flagellation</w> process under a high-powered microscope to understand cell movement.
